title: arenaria leptoclados var. viscidula
intro: Arenaria leptoclados var. viscidula, commonly known as Sticky Sandwort, is a plant species within the Caryophyllaceae family, native to Europe and western Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety and promoting sleep due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Sticky Sandwort are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant properties, and potentially lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent.
